title: Set Config (topic form set-config)
description: Entry schema of the topic form set-config (topic.abnf, matrix row Set/Config, MG 9.1.3): a partial update of one Config DataSet. That it is the DataSet addressed by Source and Filter of the topic (DataSetWriterName, WriterGroupName) and the Validation of the values (REQ-RES-CONFIG-008) are rules of the rule layer; that it matches the published Config is checked by D7 test and monitor (REQ-RES-CONFIG-005/011/023). Config has no Del (REQ-TOP-013); a value is unset with an empty string (REQ-RES-CONFIG-010).

allOf.$comment: REQ-MSG-011 (MG 8.2.1): the DataSetClassId of a predefined resource is present

Messages.$comment: Exactly one Config DataSetMessage, no helper DataSet (MG 9.1.3)

allOf.$comment: REQ-PAG-008 (MG 8.3.11): a PaginationRequest is only sent with the method Get
REQ-PAG-009 (MG 8.3.11): a Set is not paginated
REQ-PAG-008 (MG 8.3.11): a Pagination is only sent with the method Pub
REQ-PAG-009 (MG 8.3.11): a Set is not paginated

then.$comment: REQ-LOC-003 (MG 8.3.12): a Locale is only sent with the method Get
REQ-QRY-001 (MG 8.3.13): a Query is only sent with the method Get

allOf.$comment: REQ-RES-CONFIG-019 (MG 9.1.3, SF-079): a Set Config carries exactly one Config DataSetMessage
REQ-BUS-010 (MG 8.2.3): a DataSetMessage in a Set or Del request carries no SequenceNumber
